Hi Sofia — thanks for the doc. Putting a short, plain‑English draft below for procurement; copied Laura (product comms) and Kimberly (legal) to validate.

Draft for RFP (suggested, 2–3 short bullets + one sentence):
• Redwood Inference hosts customer workloads in region‑specific clusters; customers can select data residency options for hosted deployments where available.
• Where customers choose cross‑border processing, Redwood uses industry standard safeguards (SCCs or equivalent contractual mechanisms) and technical controls such as encryption in transit and at rest.
• For regulated customers who require on‑prem or VPC deployments, we offer Dedicated and Private deployment options to avoid cross‑border transfer.

Short export‑control note (one line):
Redwood’s hosted API is primarily a software service; we do not export controlled hardware or restricted source code. Customers with specific export‑control concerns should contact our compliance team for tailored guidance.

Questions for internal reviewers:
• Kimberly — is the "SCCs or equivalent" phrasing safe or should we say "SCCs or other lawful transfer mechanisms"?
• Laura — can you make the bullets even more concise for the procurement one‑pager?

I attached a working FAQ doc (redwood_faq_export-controls-draft.docx). Happy to iterate.

Thanks,
